identitySignals: Name matches the registered nonprofit 'National Park Foundation' in Washington, DC (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer and GuideStar, EIN 52-1086761), the congressionally chartered official charity of the National Park Service

The agenda item is a grant for Point Reyes National Seashore, a National Park Service site in the Bay Area, which fits the National Park Foundation's mission of funding national parks and youth programs
The grant funds Oakland Goes Outdoors, an OUSD middle school outdoor program that partners with the National Park Service and Point Reyes National Seashore (Oakland Goes Outdoors FAQ)
OUSD's contract category 'Classroom & academic programs' is consistent with the foundation's student and youth park education grants

profile.summary: The National Park Foundation is the official charity of the National Park Service. Congress chartered it in 1967. It raises private money and builds partnerships to support national parks, including grants for youth and education programs and park preservation.
